QuestInfo.name: Hundreds and Thousands of Children 2
QuestInfo.0: The Lion King was having conversations with a shamaness who emits an absolutely evil aura. Could she be recruiting the Lion King to help her destroy Maple World? You barely escape the castle with help from Alicia. When you open your eyes, you are stunned at the horrors before you.
QuestInfo.1: The monsters are attacking the refugees. You need to stop them!
QuestInfo.2: You stopped the attack, but you couldn't save everyone. With this reality heavy on your mind, you head towards the Dragon Master's Beacon to report.
